freezeAuthorization: Root explicitly authorized comparison after frozen Solver and independent QA.

comparisons.rootCause: MATCH: unquoted parser stops on internal whitespace instead of line boundary.
comparisons.behavior: Core space preservation succeeds, but bare carriage-return line boundaries regress. A=foo\rB=bar parsed into two bindings before patch, only one A binding after. Historical fix preserves both CR and LF as boundaries.
comparisons.tests: Replay9table cases and5independent QA cases coverLF,CRLF,comments,expansion but omitCR-only. Auditor executed same harness against exact baseline archive and frozen replay; mismatch confirmed.
comparisons.scope: Replay narrower than accepted refactor, retaining legacy helpers. Narrow scope is acceptable but CR-boundary regression is not.
comparisons.simplicity: Forward comment scan is straightforward and handles multiple hashes better than historical reverse search; newline-only scanning is insufficient.
comparisons.regressions: One audit-detected behavioral regression: bare-CR-separated assignments lose following variables. Full Go tests/race/vet/build passed yet missed this case.
